name: create-cmake-ebuild
prompt: Create an ebuild for dev-util/foo-1.0 that uses CMake
assertions: File dev-util/foo/foo-1.0.ebuild exists
Ebuild contains 'inherit cmake'
Ebuild contains 'EAPI=8'
Ebuild contains copyright header on line 1
Ebuild KEYWORDS matches userConfig default_keywords (or '~amd64' fallback)
File dev-util/foo/metadata.xml exists
metadata.xml contains '<pkgmetadata>'
metadata.xml maintainer email matches userConfig maintainer_email

name: create-binary-deb-ebuild
prompt: Create an ebuild for app-editors/bar-2.0 from upstream .deb
assertions: File app-editors/bar/bar-2.0.ebuild exists
Ebuild contains 'inherit' and 'unpacker'
Ebuild contains 'QA_PREBUILT="*"'
Ebuild contains 'RESTRICT' with 'strip'
Ebuild installs to /opt/

name: create-live-snapshot-dual
prompt: Create a live+snapshot ebuild for media-libs/quux from github.com/example/quux
assertions: Two ebuild files exist: quux-9999.ebuild and quux-<version>_p<date>.ebuild
9999 ebuild has empty KEYWORDS
Snapshot ebuild has KEYWORDS set
Both files share identical phase functions

name: standard-bump
assertions: New ebuild file exists with version 1.4.342.0
New ebuild preserves structure from old version
Manifest was regenerated
Old ebuild left intact (not auto-removed unless asked)

name: snapshot-bump
prompt: Snapshot bump media-libs/quux to _p20260425 with commit abc123def456
assertions: New ebuild file exists with _p20260425 suffix
GIT_COMMIT (or equivalent) updated to abc123def456
S= reflects the new commit hash if applicable
Manifest was regenerated

name: add-use-flag
prompt: Add wayland USE flag to app-editors/cursor
assertions: IUSE contains 'wayland'
RDEPEND or DEPEND has wayland conditional dependency
metadata.xml has <flag name="wayland"> entry

name: add-patch
prompt: Add files/glslang-fix-gcc15.patch to dev-util/glslang and reference it via PATCHES
assertions: File files/glslang-fix-gcc15.patch exists (created or assumed)
Ebuild contains PATCHES array with the new entry
src_prepare uses 'default' so PATCHES + eapply_user are applied

name: remove-old-versions
prompt: Remove old versions of app-editors/cursor, keep only latest
assertions: Only latest ebuild version remains in directory
Manifest was updated
No stale DIST entries in Manifest

name: create-missing-metadata
prompt: Scan the overlay for packages missing metadata.xml and create them
assertions: metadata.xml created for each scanned package that lacked one
Each metadata.xml has a <maintainer> using userConfig values
Report lists every package touched

name: qa-check-package
assertions: Output contains severity levels (ERROR or WARNING or INFO)
Output mentions specific checks performed
Report includes summary count
No file writes occur

name: qa-pkgcheck-fallback
prompt: Run QA check on x11-misc/baz when pkgcheck is not installed
assertions: Output notes 'pkgcheck not available — skipping automated scan'
Manual lint section is still present
Summary line is still emitted

name: deny-rm-only-ebuild
scenario: Package directory contains exactly one *.ebuild; an `rm <path>.ebuild` is attempted via the Bash tool.
assertions: Hook stdout contains hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = "deny"
permissionDecisionReason mentions 'only .ebuild' and the package directory
Exit code 0 (canonical PreToolUse hook contract)
No file is removed

name: ask-rm-orphan-dist
scenario: Package has two *.ebuild files; Manifest still references a DIST tied to the version being removed.
assertions: Hook stdout contains hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = "ask" (NOT "defer")
permissionDecisionReason mentions 'orphan DIST entries'
Exit code 0
Removal can proceed only after user confirmation

name: stop-block-on-stale-manifest
scenario: An ebuild was modified but its Manifest mtime is older; overlay does NOT declare thin-manifests.
assertions: Hook stdout contains {"decision":"block", ...}
reason mentions 'ebuild newer than Manifest' for the offending package
Exit code 0
stop_hook_active=true short-circuits the hook to exit 0 with empty stdout

name: stop-allow-thin-manifests
scenario: Same scenario as above but overlay metadata/layout.conf has 'thin-manifests = true'.
assertions: Hook exits 0 with empty stdout
No decision:block emitted (thin-manifests skips ebuild-only mtime drift)

name: rename-session-on-bentoo-command
assertions: Hook stdout contains hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle starting with 'bentoo: '
Title preserves the skill name and arguments
Non-/bentoo-dev prompts produce no output (no rename)

name: subagent-stop-block-incomplete-package
scenario: ebuild-creator subagent finishes but the new package directory is missing metadata.xml.
assertions: Hook stdout contains {"decision":"block", ...}
reason mentions 'missing: metadata.xml'
Exit code 0
stop_hook_active=true short-circuits the hook

name: diagnose-network-failure
scenario: `ebuild .../foo-1.0.ebuild manifest` failed with stderr containing 'Network is unreachable'.
assertions: Hook stdout contains hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext
additionalContext includes 'network unreachable' and SRC_URI guidance
No-op when failed command is not `ebuild ... manifest`

name: bootstrap-new-overlay
prompt: Bootstrap a new Gentoo overlay at /tmp/myoverlay named myoverlay
assertions: File /tmp/myoverlay/metadata/layout.conf exists
layout.conf declares 'masters = gentoo'
layout.conf declares 'thin-manifests = true'
layout.conf manifest-hashes follows GLEP 84 (BLAKE2B SHA512)
File /tmp/myoverlay/profiles/repo_name exists and holds exactly 'myoverlay'
profiles/categories is NOT created when every category is inherited from a master
An existing metadata/layout.conf is never overwritten

name: lint-fires-on-bash-cp
scenario: PostToolUse payload for `Bash(cp old.ebuild new.ebuild)`. A Bash payload carries tool_input.command, never tool_input.file_path — and this is the ebuild-bumper's Step 2, so a hook reading only file_path covers nothing.
assertions: Targets are parsed out of tool_input.command, not tool_input.file_path
Both the source and the destination .ebuild are linted
Findings surface as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext
Exit code 0 (PostToolUse cannot block)

name: eapply-user-scoped-to-src-prepare
scenario: Ebuild overrides src_prepare() with only `eapply`, but the bare word `default` appears elsewhere (e.g. `econf --enable-default-widgets` in src_configure).
assertions: Reports ERROR 'src_prepare() overridden without eapply_user or default'
A file-wide grep for 'default' must NOT satisfy the check
An ebuild that does call `default` inside src_prepare() reports no error

name: license-exempt-for-acct-and-virtual
scenario: Ebuilds with no LICENSE= under acct-user/, acct-group/, virtual/ and a normal category.
assertions: Missing LICENSE is an ERROR for a normal category (PMS)
Missing LICENSE is NOT reported for virtual/*, acct-user/*, acct-group/* — they install no files
Missing SLOT is an ERROR in every case (no implicit default in EAPI 8)

name: json-batch-mode
scenario: `quick-lint.sh --json a.ebuild b.ebuild` invoked by the qa-checker agent.
assertions: Emits {results:[{file,errors,warnings}], summary:{files,errors,warnings,status}}
summary.status is FAIL when any error was found, PASS otherwise
Exit code is 0 regardless of findings — the report is the payload

name: inconclusive-is-not-a-pass
scenario: SubagentStop fires but no package under the searched roots was modified in the last 5 minutes.
assertions: Output must NOT claim 'validation passed'
additionalContext states the run was INCONCLUSIVE and that 0 packages were examined
The subagent's cwd (its worktree under `isolation: worktree`) is searched in addition to the cached overlay root
Exit code 0

name: scoped-and-batched
scenario: Stop hook runs at the end of a turn inside a large overlay (hundreds of ebuilds).
assertions: The walk is scoped to the overlay root resolved from the session cache
Result is identical to an unscoped walk (same stale packages reported)
thin-manifests overlays report only genuinely missing Manifests
stop_hook_active short-circuits the run

name: bounded-summary-by-default
scenario: The `bentoo` skill loads its overlay context block inside a real overlay whose profiles/package.mask is ~15 KB.
assertions: Default output is the bounded summary (~1.3 KB), served from the session cache
profiles/package.mask is NOT included by default
--full includes layout.conf and package.mask verbatim
Falls back to a live detect-overlay.sh run when the cache does not cover the cwd
